info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Replace Partner By Application Id-spec
info.description: The Partner Management API facilitates the updating of partner associations by application ID within a microservices architecture. This endpoint allows businesses to modify existing partner data associated with a specific application, enabling seamless integration and management of partner relationships. Typical consumers include application developers and system integrators looking to dynamically update partner configurations. This enhances operational flexibility and ensures that application partnerships are aligned with current business strategies.

put.description: This operation updates the details of a specific partner application identified by its ID. Ensure that all required fields are provided in the request to successfully modify the application.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the application with the specified ID. It includes necessary attributes and fields required for a successful update of the application's status and details.

200.description: Request completed successfully and resource updated.
